blocks.text: Listings of houses in West Central rose from 68 in June to 71 in October (+4.4%), and 22 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 18.3% of Maple Ridge’s 388 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in West Central?

blocks.text: West Central Maple Ridge Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: The streets that define this page in practice are Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road running east–west, with 207 Street, Laity Street and 216 Street as the north–south house streets between the Pitt Meadows border and 221 Street at the Town Centre.
The Lougheed Transit Corridor, which covers this area's two main roads, runs from Maple Ridge's western boundary to the Town Centre at 221 Street.

blocks.text: West Central Maple Ridge Houses: the housing stock

items.t: Schools sitting in or at the edge of these house streets are Alouette Elementary at 22155 Isaac Crescent, Glenwood Elementary at 21410 Glenwood Avenue and Laity View Elementary at 21023 123 Avenue.

blocks.text: West Central Maple Ridge Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The rule that changes houses here is the Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan, adopted January 27, 2026, which supports increased residential and commercial density on lots near Lougheed Highway and the future Bus Rapid Transit stations; the City states the plan does not immediately change any property's zoning.

West Central's eastern edge falls in the Town Centre's transit-oriented area framework: the Town Centre Area Plan, updated November 25, 2025, builds in the Transit-Oriented Areas designated by Bylaw No. 8001-2024 around Haney Transit Exchange and Port Haney Station.

blocks.text: West Central Maple Ridge Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: The hospital is a local traffic fact, not just a service: Ridge Meadows Hospital sits at 11666 Laity Street, and Laity Street is also one of the four future Bus Rapid Transit station streets named in the corridor plan.

Secondary options at the area's edges are Maple Ridge Secondary at 21911 122 Avenue and Westview Secondary at 20905 Wicklund Avenue; School District 42 has no middle-school tier, with elementary Kindergarten to Grade 7 and secondary Grades 8 to 12.

blocks.text: West Central Maple Ridge Houses: development and new projects

items.t: On May 12, 2026 Council endorsed TransLink's 30% concept design for the Langley–Haney Place Bus Rapid Transit line, including centre-running dedicated bus lanes on Lougheed Highway between Maple Meadows Way and 222 Street at the Haney Bypass, and directed staff to continue to detailed design.

blocks.text: West Central Maple Ridge Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: The neighbourhood-specific cost angle is licensing: a West Central owner renting both a main house and a suite needs a City business licence, with the $500 one-time Application Review Fee stated on the City's suite page.

blocks.text: West Central Maple Ridge Houses: getting around

items.t: The planned rapid transit for these streets is bus, not rail: four of the five Maple Ridge Bus Rapid Transit stations — 203 Street, 207 Street, Laity Street and 216 Street on Lougheed Highway — sit in or beside this area, with the terminus at Haney Place Transit Exchange.
TransLink's Haney Place diagram shows the R3 Lougheed Hwy RapidBus and routes 701, 733, 741, 743, 744, 745, 746, 748, 749 and 791 using Haney Place Exchange, one exchange east of this area.

blocks.text: Jared's take on West Central Maple Ridge

Taking in Port Haney and the Ridge Meadows Hospital corridor on Laity Street, West Central is the west side of the Town Centre. The house streets between Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road have big older lots.
West Central home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

58 houses sold in West Central with a median price of $1,045,000 (the middle half sold between $936,250 and $1,193,750), taking a median of 20 days to sell at 96.3% of the last list price; 5% sold above list. They had a median $483 per square foot, a median year built of 1972 and a median lot of 8,360 square feet.

faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 71 houses listed in West Central. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.
faq.q: How many houses are for sale in West Central?

faq.a: In October 2026, houses in West Central had a sales ratio of 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
faq.q: Is West Central a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?

faq.a: 22 houses sold in West Central over those 5 months, out of 247 in all of Maple Ridge.
faq.q: How many houses sold in West Central from June to October 2026?

faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.a: 58 houses sold in West Central between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,045,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in West Central?
